title: params of evidence.export
description: The kit's half of the per-app evidence bundle (KDEC-039): for this repository, at one commit or one release (a kit-release-record deployment, read for its commit). Exactly one of commit and release (API_SCHEMA_VIOLATION otherwise); a repository other than the one this API serves is API_REPOSITORY_NOT_SERVED. A read: no idempotency key.

release.description: The id of a GitHub deployment with task kit-release-record (the durable release record).

repository.description: Optional: the repository the caller expects. Must be the one this API serves.
